33696.en: Let :g:`I_{A}I_{B}I_{C} << I_A I_B I_C >>` be the excentral triangle. Let L_{A} be the trilinear polar of I wrt :g:`BCI_{A} << B C I_A >>`, and define L_{B} and L_{C} cyclically. Let A' = L_{B} ∩ L_{C}, B' = L_{C} ∩ L_{A}, C' = L_{A} ∩ L_{B}. Let A" be the reflection of A' in BC, and define B" and C" cyclically. The lines AA", BB", CC" concur in X_33696. (Randy Hutson, August 19, 2019)
